kit_version: not installed; direct contribution against a5fddc7
need: Agents comparing an outside tool or practice with the project's own tended to treat the current design and earlier decisions as the standard to beat, so the comparison favoured what already existed and reasons that no longer held went unexamined.
evidence: In one project the owner corrected this three times in one week while agents assessed outside skills and delivery models. After the corrections, a reassessment of the same outside skills reversed two rejections given earlier in that review, and the project added the rule and produced a measured comparison of three delivery models that kept the current one for named reasons.
limits: Observed in one project over one week. This is guidance: no kit check can judge whether an assessment favoured the current design, and no mechanical enforcement is claimed. It has not been adopted by another project. The source project does not install the kit, so this is a direct contribution rather than an installed-release export.
sanitization: Removed the project's tool, model and task names, host names and paths. No credentials, private account data, employer, client or third-party material is included.
